history.sg_progress: In accordance with General Assembly mandates, inter alia, under Assembly resolution 70/286, the Secretariat builds, maintains and manages global rosters in response to being urged “to make every effort to reduce the recruitment lead time for staff in field missions”. While the roster management system had undergone continuous updates and improvements in 2021, as confirmed by a recommendation of the Board of Auditors, the Secretariat embarked on a restructuring of the system with the aim of standardizing operational aspects of roster building, association and management. This entails, inter alia, the provision of detailed roster-related guidance to users, reassessing roster validity and time limitation and addressing aspects of roster diversity. The restructuring is scheduled for completion by the end of 2023.
